title: Common definitions (DRAFT bridge-draft-0)
description: DRAFT. Shared building blocks. Shapes were read off the site-reference-v1 fixtures (PR #19); anything not observed there is marked in bridge/protocol/open-questions.md.

Coord.description: Board cell, used as board[row][col]. Observed: row 0 is black's back rank, white pawns start on row 6.

PerColor.description: An integer kept per side, e.g. turnsTaken.

Piece.description: A piece on the board. type/color/moved were present on every piece in all 349 fixtures. Many other per-piece flags exist (hp, maxHp, shielded, frozen, mana, ...); a few are listed as optional known fields and any other key is allowed and must be passed through untouched (additionalProperties: true) until the team fixes the full list.

type.description: Piece kind, e.g. pawn, king, amazon. 50 different kinds were seen in the fixtures; deliberately not enumerated here.

Winner.description: null = not decided yet. "draw" comes from docs/GAME-RULES.md (some card effects end the game in a draw); it was not observed in the fixtures.
